# Issue #341 benchmark report

## Discoveries
- `run_record.py` currently validates only that `manifest_sha256` has SHA-256 shape; it does not compare the value with supplied manifest bytes (`benchmark/scripts/run_record.py`, `validate`).
- The checker already has a synthetic record/manifest fixture and mutation harness in `check()`, which can host the binding controls.

## Status
- Startup documents and `benchmark/scripts/run_record.py` have been read.
- Required template and README sections still need inspection before implementation.
- No code or pin changes have been made yet.

## What next
Read `benchmark/baseline/run-record.template.json`, the run-record sections of `benchmark/baseline/README.md`, and preparation pins. Then add a stdlib byte-hash binding function, matching and wrong-content controls, revert-proof evidence, README update, and refreshed pins. Run the required evaluator and baseline checks without creating `__pycache__` files.
